# Verify the exact vendored upstream bytes before configuring the dependency.
file(STRINGS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libsamplerate/SHA256SUMS" checksums)
foreach(entry IN LISTS checksums)
  string(SUBSTRING "${entry}" 0 64 expected)
  string(SUBSTRING "${entry}" 66 -1 filename)
  file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libsamplerate/${filename}" actual)
  if(NOT actual STREQUAL expected)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "libsamplerate checksum mismatch: ${filename}")
  endif()
endforeach()
# Directory scope keeps vendor CTest settings out of the parent project.
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(LIBSAMPLERATE_EXAMPLES OFF)
set(LIBSAMPLERATE_INSTALL OFF)
set(LIBSAMPLERATE_ENABLE_SINC_FAST_CONVERTER ON)
set(LIBSAMPLERATE_ENABLE_SINC_MEDIUM_CONVERTER OFF)
set(LIBSAMPLERATE_ENABLE_SINC_BEST_CONVERTER OFF)
add_subdirectory(libsamplerate)
